# Barima Homes

> Barima Homes sells litigation-free land, houses and apartments in Ghana, so what a buyer pays for is truly theirs. It operates in Ghana only and is part of Barima Holdings.

## What we sell

- Land: litigation-free plots in Ghana
- Houses: family homes and ready-to-move-in houses in Ghana
- Apartments: modern apartments in Ghana
- Current properties for sale, with photos and video tours, are on the listings page.
